verdict.rationale: Gitea provides building blocks for governance—branch protection via permission/ACL management, PR-based code review, and Actions CI/CD workflows—but the evidence pack shows no organization-wide policy enforcement (no cross-repo required-status-checks enforcement, no centralized compliance dashboard, no audit/reporting for standards adherence across teams). Community feedback also notes Gitea intentionally avoids bundling broader DevOps governance features that GitLab includes. missing for 10: org-wide policy enforcement mechanisms, centralized compliance/audit reporting across repos, evidence of branch-protection/required-CI-status enforcement, third-party validation of governance at scale.
